note: Written by hand from data/austin.txt. Every entry is an obligation placed on the owner or operator. Permissions are deliberately excluded: 4-23-33(C) says an operator MAY serve as their own local contact, which requires nothing of anyone. Facts are excluded too: 4-23-32(C)(1) says a licence lasts two years, which is a property of the licence rather than a duty, and the duty to renew lives in 4-23-42.

4-23-32: Must obtain an operator's licence to operate a short-term rental
Must obtain a separate licence for each short-term rental
May not transfer the licence; it does not pass with a sale of the property
Must include the licence number in any advertisement or promotion
May not advertise, or let anyone else advertise, without a valid licence
4-23-33: The local contact must be an individual, present in the Austin Metro Area, authorised to make decisions and resolve emergencies
The local contact must respond within two hours of being contacted about an emergency and act on it
The local contact must be present at the rental within two hours if a City employee asks
4-23-34: Must comply with all local, state and federal laws
Must ensure each guest complies with those laws
Must implement and maintain mitigation requirements where they apply
Must update application information within five days of it changing
When renting less than a whole unit, must give the guest exclusive use of a bedroom and shared use of a full bathroom
Must give each guest the information packet and a list of fire extinguisher locations
May not use sound equipment above 75 decibels at the property line between 10:00 and 22:00
May not use sound equipment audible beyond the property line between 22:00 and 10:00
May not make noise or play an instrument audible to an adjacent property between 22:30 and 07:00
